stories.title: Consent Tier Evaluation and Transition Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to evaluate current consent tier (none, Tier 1, Tier 2), enforce valid transitions, and trigger required actions such as summarization and de-identification when upgrading tiers. Prevent invalid downgrades or bypass paths.

stories.title: Consent Contract Validation and De-identification Rules
stories.description: Define and enforce validation rules ensuring no PHI is persisted without appropriate consent tier. Implement Safe Harbor de-identification checks and contract-level guards before storage or downstream service calls.
